mainEntity.name: What results should I realistically expect from an AI webinar?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong webinar outcome is not simply a finished slide deck; it is a clear attendee action, useful learning, and measurable follow-up. Depending on the purpose, track attendance, participation, questions, completion of a worksheet, qualified follow-up requests, or progress toward a product or newsletter goal. Context: Run My AI Biz presents AI applications as educational opportunities, not guaranteed income or growth. A webinar should therefore test understanding and usefulness rather than promise a particular business result. Key factors: - The event’s primary objective - Baseline registration and attendance - Quality of questions and feedback - Follow-up behavior Practical guidance: Define one primary metric and two supporting indicators before the event. Add a short post-event survey asking what was clear, confusing, and actionable. Use the responses to revise the next outline, prompts, examples, and call to action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect clearer education, audience feedback, questions, and possible follow-up—not guaranteed sales or income. Define one primary goal before the event, such as teaching a workflow or generating qualified conversations, then measure attendance, participation, feedback, and the next action rather than relying only on views.
